sect.p: 1.(1) In this Act Minister means the Minister for the Environment, Heritage and Local Government.
(2) In the Schedule to this Act
(a) a reference to a former rural district shall be construed as a reference to that district as constituted immediately before 1 October 1925, and
(b) a reference to a line drawn along any motorway, road, railway or street shall be construed as a reference to a line drawn along the centre of such motorway, road, railway or street.
